t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes all relate to one of two colored baskets; a red, or yellow basket. One of these baskets will always have a higher score than the other, but this may switch at any time, so pay attention to gain a higher score. Also pay attention to the score multiplier, as it will allow you to make the most out of your points you gain per basket.

vb_textbox.text: In the game, each gnome (for example, the blue gnome) will correspond to one of the two coloured baskets - red or yellow. As the game goes on, you should do your best to learn which gnome offers which basket (for example, the blue gnome may use the yellow basket). Throughout the game, the basket that earns the most points/mushrooms will change between the red and yellow basket. Because of this, it is not only important to learn which gnomes use which basket, but it's also important to take note when the basket earns more than the other, and when it changes. The score multiplier will help you earn more, with up to a point multiplier of 5. The more mushrooms your basket gets, the more points you earn. Make sure to do this in time, as you will get 1.5 seconds to decide, followed by learning how many points you earned. Good luck!
